headline: iPhone Ultra rumored to feature two new display sizes this fall
summary: Apple is reportedly planning to introduce two entirely new display sizes and shapes for the iPhone Ultra, expected to launch this fall.
details: This fall, Apple is rumored to be introducing the iPhone Ultra, a new high-end model that will reportedly feature two display sizes and shapes never before seen on an iPhone.
While specific dimensions are not yet available, the "Ultra" moniker suggests a premium device with cutting-edge technology and potentially a larger screen or a foldable design.
This move would mark a significant departure from Apple's current iPhone lineup, which offers a limited range of screen sizes within standard and Pro models.
The introduction of new display form factors could indicate Apple's exploration of foldable technology or simply a desire to offer a more diverse range of screen options to consumers.

headline_marked: WhatsApp [[shares Apple Music activity]] to Status
headline: WhatsApp shares Apple Music activity to Status
summary: The messaging app now allows users to share what they're listening to on Apple Music directly to their WhatsApp Status, enhancing social music discovery.
details: WhatsApp has rolled out a new feature enabling users to share their Apple Music listening activity to their WhatsApp Status.
This integration allows friends and followers to see what songs or artists you are enjoying on Apple Music directly within your WhatsApp Status updates.
The feature aims to enhance social interaction by bridging music listening habits with messaging, making it easier to share musical tastes.
This update also includes other enhancements, such as Adobe Acrobat integration directly into WhatsApp Web, streamlining document sharing and collaboration.
